import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static Map<Integer, Integer>[] edge = new HashMap[7000];
    static char[][] buf = new char[20][20];
    static int n, m, vn, from[], flow[], tox[][] = new int[10][10];
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int encode(int x, int y, int t) {
        return x + y * n + t * n * n + 2;
    }

    static int augment(int s, int t, int cap) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        for (int f = 1; f > 0; f--) {
            from = new int[vn];
            Arrays.fill(from, -1);
            from[s] = s;
            flow = new int[vn];
            flow[s] = cap;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int x = q.poll();
                if (x == t) {
                    int curr = x;
                    while (curr != s) {
                        int prev = from[curr];
                        edge[prev].put(curr, edge[prev].get(curr) - flow[t]);
                        edge[curr].put(prev, edge[curr].getOrDefault(prev, 0) + flow[t]);
                        curr = prev;
                    }
                    total_flow += flow[t];
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> e : edge[x].entrySet()) {
                    int toNode = e.getKey();
                    int capacity = e.getValue();
                    if (capacity >= cap && from[toNode] == -1) {
                        from[toNode] = x;
                        flow[toNode] = Math.min(capacity, flow[x]);
                        q.offer(toNode);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < 7000; i++) {
            edge[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            buf[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                buf[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                    edge[0].put(encode(i, j, 0), buf[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] tox = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : tox) {
            Arrays.fill(row, m + 1);
        }

        Queue<int[]> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (buf[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    tox[i][j] = 0;
                    bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = bfs.poll();
            int i = p[0], j = p[1];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int t = tox[i][j];
                int x = i + dx[dir], y = j + dy[dir];
                if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && buf[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < tox[x][y]) {
                    tox[x][y] = t + 1;
                    bfs.offer(new int[]{x, y});
                }
            }
        }

        vn = encode(n - 1, n - 1, m) + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < m; t++) {
                    if (t < m) {
                        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
                            int x = i + dx[q], y = j + dy[q];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && buf[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < tox[x][y] + (buf[x][y] > '0' && buf[x][y] <= '9' ? 1 : 0) && t < tox[i][j]) {
                                edge[encode(i, j, t)].put(encode(x, y, t + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                            edge[encode(i, j, t)].put(encode(i, j, m), buf[i][j] - '0');
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                    edge[encode(i, j, m)].put(1, buf[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            res += augment(0, 1, u);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
